title: Linking disaster-risk financing with adaptive social protection
discussion_signal: The post presents disaster-risk financing and adaptive social protection as linked systems, suggesting that poverty protection can be designed to respond to shocks rather than operate only as a static safety net. It connects financial architecture to household recovery and state capacity.
linked_research_question: How do financing and delivery systems determine whether social protection reaches households before, during, and after disasters?
limits: No implementation or beneficiary outcome is shown
The post does not compare coverage across countries
